content.text:
Checking the report's failures: (1) the interaction feature had no predictive power, with weak IC and about half coverage due to the long history requirement; (2) the second submission was invalid because the hypothesis exceeded the word limit by two words.

The proposed hypothesis is a spread, not an interaction, so it changes the feature form. But it still uses a 60-month standardization, which likely keeps the long history requirement and the coverage problem. It does not condition on regime. The hypothesis is also long; I count roughly 35 words, and the limit is unknown, so I can't verify whether it avoids the word-limit failure.

It doesn't explicitly avoid the coverage problem, since 60-month windows persist. It doesn't explicitly address the weak-IC failure beyond changing the form. The word limit is unclear.

Overall, it does not explicitly avoid the failures.

{"avoids_failure": false}
